independent_read_scope.main_text: Complete extracted PDF pages 10, 11, 14, 15, 16, 17, 20, 21 and 22. This includes complete Methods (pages 14-17), relevant genetic/drug Results (10-11), Figure 2 legend and Figure 3 legend. It is a bounded check, not a full-paper independent reread.

checks.evidence: PDF page 22 Figure 3H legend: EB3-GFP/H2B-CherryFP cells received 100 nM SC or hGwl siRNA, were synchronized with thymidine 24 h later, then treated or untreated with 500 nM OA six hours after release. Images every ten minutes. Page 14 Methods identifies Calbiochem as OA supplier.
checks.limits: The inspected Methods do not provide OA catalog, form, lot or stock vehicle. No treatment washout or explicit total OA exposure duration is supplied by the Figure 3H legend.

checks.evidence_locator: PDF page 11 Results; independent means are text-reported, not digitized from the boxplot.
checks.limits: OA advances entry in SC controls as well. Similar mean timing is not a demonstrated equivalence test. The plotted counts are cells, not independently identified culture replicates or percentages of all cells successfully rescued.

checks.evidence_locator: Original Figure 3H pixels, main-26.png; caption on PDF page 22.
checks.test: Caption specifies two-tailed unpaired Student t-tests. No bracket establishes equality between OA-treated groups.
checks.limits: Caption calls the plots boxplots with 5-95% confidence intervals; no raw-data recalculation or correction of that source terminology was attempted. Handling of non-entering cells and independent experiment counts remain incompletely specified in inspected material.

checks.evidence_locator: PDF page 22 Figure 3G legend and original panel G on main-26.png; related Results pages 10-11.

values.denominator: PP2AC siRNA alone, separately set to 100%

checks.normalization: Phospho-serine CDK-substrate signal equalized against beta-tubulin before comparison with each respective baseline.
checks.limits: These are genetic depletion arms, not OA treatments; 20-to-64 is not a common-baseline drug response or a functional rescue probability. Results attribute an approximately 15% cell-death increase to PP2A depletion, not to OA.

checks.claim: Mitotic entry is distinct from completed faithful division
checks.evidence: Figure 3H legend scores entry by DNA condensation and cell detachment. General live-imaging Methods additionally describe spindle appearance, condensed chromosomes, nucleolus loss and cell rounding. Figure 3H reports entry time, with no drug-arm completed-division or daughter-karyotype denominator. Figure 3A-C contain SC/Gwl knockdown dose arms, not OA rescue arms.
checks.limits: The result supports chemical rescue of entry delay in MASTL-depleted HeLa cells. It does not establish restored segregation fidelity, viable euploid descendants or durable productive proliferation.

checks.claim: BUBR1 measurement does not establish drug restoration
checks.evidence: Figure 2B pixels and caption (PDF page 20; main-25.png) compare scrambled versus hGwl siRNA cells stained for BUBR1 or Aurora B with DNA. There is no OA arm.
checks.limits: Localization after Gwl depletion is not a measurement of OA-mediated total BUBR1 abundance, stability or rescue of a BUB1B variant.

checks.claim: Distinct prior 20 nM positive and manuscript reading limits retained
checks.evidence: Both current appraisal artifacts explicitly keep the prior 20 nM OA/partial-CDK1-inhibition completed-mitosis result separate from this 500 nM entry-timing experiment; they state that supplement and movies were not obtained.
checks.limits: This independent check confirms preservation and nonconflation of the prior claim, not its source-level revalidation. The current manufacturer listing and broader full-main reading declaration belong to the root reader, not to this bounded independent check.

report.interpretive_conclusion: No material scientific overclaim identified in the checked appraisal/evidence version. Retain a genuine chemical entry-timing rescue while preserving the different genetic denominators, control-cell acceleration, unread supplement boundary and lack of demonstrated BUB1B or faithful-daughter rescue.

integration_status: Integrated original assessment; raw source material remains outside Git; no extra abstract credit.
